record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare ROOST: Pidove (1 star), Tranquill (2 stars), Unfezant (3 stars), all maxPP 100 and range 1 (regional units). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count only. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Self-only, three steps in this order: (1) the caster flies away - it relocates (non-forced moveTo, no skydive attack) to an empty cell beyond its own attack range that lets it reach an enemy, chosen among the least threatened and farthest candidates; all units that were targeting it lose their target; (2) the caster is put to sleep for a requested 1000 ms (subject to the sleep guards); (3) it gains a shield, requested 20 / 40 / 80 by stars here (table 20/40/80/160). Nothing is dealt to enemies. The sleep makes the caster idle for its duration and a crowd-control cooldown follows on waking, so Roost trades the caster's own actions for a shield and a repositioning. If no living enemy exists, or no destination is found, the caster stays where it is but still sleeps (if allowed) and still gains the shield.

targeting.who: the caster only (self); enemies are affected only by losing the caster as a target
targeting.note: No target is used. flyAway(board, false) asks Board.getFlyAwayCell(caster) for a destination: living enemies required; empty cells farther than the caster's range from its current cell, where at least one targettable enemy is within the caster's range; among them the ones within reach of the fewest enemies, then the farthest (Manhattan distance), then a random pick. When no such cell exists the fallback getSafePlaceAwayFrom was not read. The movement is moveTo(..., false): not forced, so canBeMoved is not consulted.

geometry.shape: relocation of the caster to one empty board cell; no area, no line

declaredRaw.description: flyAway(board, false): moveTo(destination from getFlyAwayCell, forcedDisplacement false)

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
effects.resolution: happens only if getFlyAwayCell returns a cell (a living enemy exists and a suitable empty cell is found or the fallback finds one). The caster gets protect for 2000 ms only if it already has the FEATHER_DANCE, SKYDIVE or MAX_AIRSTREAM effect (shouldProtect default); the GALE_WINGS passive leaves EMBER board effects on the cells between (not relevant to these three units). Whether or not it moves, every living unit whose target is the caster has its target cleared. The move changes the caster's state through moveTo (moving state, cooldown 100) before the sleep below is applied.

effects.scaling: called as addShield(requested, caster, 1, crit): a Big Eater Belt holder first gets round-down(requested x 1.25); then x (1 + AP/100); x critPower on a crit (canCritByDefault false, so crit needs ABILITY_CRIT); x0.5 if the caster is enraged; then Math.round.
effects.resolution: requested = 20 / 40 / 80. Applied = the scaled, rounded value added to the caster's shield (no cap; only if its hp > 0). Happens after the move and after the sleep attempt, whether or not either succeeded. Shield damage absorbed later follows the generic damage rules (not part of this record).

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
statusEffects.resolution: applied only if the caster is not already asleep, has no rune protect, is not skydiving, lacks IMMUNITY_SLEEP and its ccCooldown is <= 0; applied duration = round(requested x 1.3 at NIGHT or x0.7 at ZENITH; halved if enraged; then SWIFT_SWIM x0.7 / HYDRATION x0.5 / WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER x0.3 and Odd Keystone -10 % each). A sleeping unit is forced to the idle state; when the timer ends a CC cooldown of 1500 ms starts. An eaten Chesto Berry (if held) is triggered on application. The strategy does not guard against the sleep being refused: the shield is still granted.

starBehavior.note: Only the shield is indexed by stars (the 4-star value 160, also the ?? fallback, is not reachable by the bare factory star counts of these units). Sleep duration and the fly-away rule do not depend on stars. maxPP is 100 and range 1 for all three.

record.positionalConditions: The destination depends on the positions of living enemies and empty cells at cast time; with no living enemy or no suitable cell the caster does not move.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP, repeats the relocation (if possible), the sleep attempt and adds another shield; a new sleep cannot start while the caster is asleep or while its ccCooldown is still running.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: shield 20 / 40 / 80 (Pidove / Tranquill / Unfezant) and sleep 1000 ms. Applied shield = (Big Eater Belt x1.25 round-down) x (1 + AP/100) x optional critPower x (0.5 if enraged), rounded. Applied sleep = requested after weather, enrage and reductions, or none if a guard refuses it. The relocation is requested by flyAway and is applied only if a destination exists.
